# ListItem

Figma: [07e. ListItem](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-946) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The universal list row: a leading element + title & description + a configurable trailing slot (chevron, toggle, value, action, label), across interaction states and directions. The building block for lists, menus and settings - composed into ActionList / List (07f–07g).

### Content

Shared text block for rows and cards (Material anatomy): overline, title, supporting description plus optional value, metadata, badge, switch, rating and tags. Used by ListItem, SelectRow, List rows, AccordionItem, Carousel / Slide and NewsCard.

Level: atom · Contains: Switch, Tag · Part of: ListItem, SelectRow, List / TextItem, AccordionItem, Carousel / Slide, NewsCard

Use when:
- Text area of any list row or slide that must stay consistent with ListItem
- Building a new row molecule from the system's text block

Don't use when:
- Long body copy: use plain text styles
- Card-specific text: use CardInfo / Content or CardAction / Label

Accessibility: Title first in reading order; muted supporting text must meet AA.

### ListItem

The universal single row: leading icon, title with optional description and exactly one trailing affordance (chevron, Switch, value, Tag label or action Button). It is the row, not the list.

Level: molecule · Contains: Content, Tag, Switch, Button · Part of: ActionList

Use when:
- Settings and account rows that navigate (Has chevron) or toggle (Has toggle)
- Data rows showing a value such as balance
- Rows inside ActionList, Drawer or sheet content

Don't use when:
- Grouping rows with header, dividers and footer: use ActionList
- Choosing among options with radio or checkbox: use SelectRow inside SelectionList
- Rich standalone content: use CardInfo or CardAction
- Titling a region: use Section

Accessibility: Whole row is one target; with a toggle the Switch is the control and is labelled by the title; one trailing slot per row.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

ListItem is the single row - a leading element, a title with optional description, and one trailing affordance. It is NOT the list itself: ActionList (07f) and List (07g) stack ListItems with dividers and grouping. Use ListItem for menus, settings, selection lists, and data rows; pick exactly one trailing slot per row.

### Atomic architecture

ListItem composes the ListItem / Content atom (title + description) with reused parts: a swappable Syntropy Icon (leading), and - in the trailing slot - Tag (label), a value text, Button (action), Switch (toggle) or a chevron.

Content (atom)

Icon (leading)

Tag (04a)

Switch (03g)

Button (02a)

Chevron

### Anatomy & slots

Pick one trailing slot per row. The leading icon is swappable; description, label and divider toggle independently.

Navigation (chevron)

Toggle (Switch)

Value

Action

Label + chevron

No leading

### States

Five interaction states: Default, Hover, Pressed, Selected (brand tint), Disabled (dimmed). Background only - the content layout is unchanged.

Default

Hover

Pressed

Selected

Disabled

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Mirrors fully: leading moves to the right, the trailing slot to the left, text right-aligns, and the chevron points inward.

LTR

RTL

### Code examples

Flutter usage of ListItem.

### Navigation row

```dart
SafqahListItem(
  leading: SafqahIcons.settings,
  title: 'Account settings',
  description: 'Manage your profile and security',
  trailing: ListItemTrailing.chevron,
  onTap: () => context.push('/settings/account'),
)
```

### Toggle row

```dart
SafqahListItem(
  leading: SafqahIcons.bell,
  title: 'Push notifications',
  trailing: ListItemTrailing.toggle,
  toggleValue: enabled,
  onToggle: (v) => setState(() => enabled = v),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use ListItem for menu, settings and data rows - a clear title and exactly one trailing slot; the whole row is tappable.

Don’t

Don’t cram several trailing controls into one row (toggle + action + chevron) - pick one affordance.

Do

Group ListItems with ActionList / List (07f–07g) for dividers and sections - don’t hand-stack rows.

Don’t

Don’t use ListItem for rich standalone content - for that use CardInfo / CardAction.

### Notes from the maintainer
